#ifndef ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/toolchain.h>
#include <zephyr/linker/sections.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/util.h>
#include <zephyr/ztest_assert.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Test case structure
 *
 * This structure defines a single test case.
 */
struct ztest_test_case {
	/** Test case function pointer */
	void (*test_fn)(void);
	/** Test case name */
	const char *name;
};

/**
 * @brief Test suite node structure
 *
 * This structure defines a test suite, which groups multiple test cases.
 */
struct ztest_suite_node {
	/** Test suite name */
	const char *name;
	/** Suite setup function (optional) */
	void (*setup)(void);
	/** Suite teardown function (optional) */
	void (*teardown)(void);
	/** Function to run before each test case (optional) */
	void (*before_each)(void);
	/** Function to run after each test case (optional) */
	void (*after_each)(void);
	/** Fixture setup function (optional) */
	void (*fixture_setup)(void *data);
	/** Fixture teardown function (optional) */
	void (*fixture_teardown)(void *data);
};

/**
 * @brief Test suite structure for fixture-based tests
 *
 * This structure defines a test suite for fixture-based tests.
 */
struct ztest_fixture_suite_node {
	/** Test suite name */
	const char *name;
	/** Fixture setup function (optional) */
	void (*fixture_setup)(void *data);
	/** Fixture teardown function (optional) */
	void (*fixture_teardown)(void *data);
};

/**
 * @brief Test case structure for fixture-based tests
 *
 * This structure defines a single test case for fixture-based tests.
 */
struct ztest_fixture_test_case {
	/** Test case function pointer */
	void (*test_fn)(void *data);
	/** Test case name */
	const char *name;
};

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite
 *
 * This macro defines a test suite with optional setup/teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup_fn Function to run once before all test cases in the suite.
 * @param teardown_fn Function to run once after all test cases in the suite.
 * @param before_each_fn Function to run before each test case in the suite.
 * @param after_each_fn Function to run after each test case in the suite.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE(suite, setup_fn, teardown_fn, before_each_fn, after_each_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, setup_fn, teardown_fn, before_each_fn, after_each_fn, NULL, NULL)

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with fixture
 *
 * This macro defines a test suite with fixture setup/teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param fixture_setup_fn Function to run once before all test cases in the suite,
 *                         receiving a fixture data pointer.
 * @param fixture_teardown_fn Function to run once after all test cases in the suite,
 *                            receiving a fixture data pointer.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_F(suite, fixture_setup_fn, fixture_teardown_fn) \
	ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, fixture_setup_fn, fixture_teardown_fn)

/**
 * @brief Internal macro to define a test suite node.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param setup_fn Suite setup function.
 * @param teardown_fn Suite teardown function.
 * @param before_each_fn Function to run before each test case.
 * @param after_each_fn Function to run after each test case.
 * @param fixture_setup_fn Fixture setup function.
 * @param fixture_teardown_fn Fixture teardown function.
 */
#define ZTEST_SUITE_DEFINE(suite, setup_fn, teardown_fn, before_each_fn, after_each_fn, \
			   fixture_setup_fn, fixture_teardown_fn) \
	const struct ztest_suite_node __used \
	__attribute__((__section__(".ztest_suites"))) \
	_ztest_suite_##suite = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.setup = setup_fn, \
		.teardown = teardown_fn, \
		.before_each = before_each_fn, \
		.after_each = after_each_fn, \
		.fixture_setup = fixture_setup_fn, \
		.fixture_teardown = fixture_teardown_fn, \
	};

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_DMEM
#define ZTEST_DMEM_SECTION __attribute__((section(".dmem")))
#else
#define ZTEST_DMEM_SECTION
#endif

#ifdef CONFIG_ZTEST_BMEM
#define ZTEST_BMEM_SECTION __attribute__((section(".bmem")))
#else
#define ZTEST_BMEM_SECTION
#endif

/**
 * @brief Internal macro to define a test case.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 * @param section_attr Optional section attribute for the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, section_attr) \
	static void ztest_##suite##_##name(void); \
	const struct ztest_test_case __used \
	section_attr \
	__attribute__((__section__(".ztest_cases"))) \
	_ztest_case_##suite##_##name = { \
		.test_fn = ztest_##suite##_##name, \
		.name = #name, \
	}; \
	static void ztest_##suite##_##name(void)

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * This macro defines a test case within a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_CASE(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, )

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with data memory attribute.
 *
 * This macro defines a test case that will be placed in data memory.
 * Requires CONFIG_ZTEST_DMEM to be enabled.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_CASE_DMEM(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, ZTEST_DMEM_SECTION)

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with BSS memory attribute.
 *
 * This macro defines a test case that will be placed in BSS memory.
 * Requires CONFIG_ZTEST_BMEM to be enabled.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_CASE_BMEM(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_CASE_DEFINE(suite, name, ZTEST_BMEM_SECTION)

/**
 * @brief Internal macro to define a fixture test case.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 * @param section_attr Optional section attribute for the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_FCASE_DEFINE(suite, name, section_attr) \
	static void ztest_f_##suite##_##name(void *data); \
	const struct ztest_fixture_test_case __used \
	section_attr \
	__attribute__((__section__(".ztest_f_cases"))) \
	_ztest_f_case_##suite##_##name = { \
		.test_fn = ztest_f_##suite##_##name, \
		.name = #name, \
	}; \
	static void ztest_f_##suite##_##name(void *data)

/**
 * @brief Define a fixture test case.
 *
 * This macro defines a test case for a fixture-based test suite.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_FCASE(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_FCASE_DEFINE(suite, name, )

/**
 * @brief Define a fixture test case with data memory attribute.
 *
 * This macro defines a fixture test case that will be placed in data memory.
 * Requires CONFIG_ZTEST_DMEM to be enabled.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_FCASE_DMEM(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_FCASE_DEFINE(suite, name, ZTEST_DMEM_SECTION)

/**
 * @brief Define a fixture test case with BSS memory attribute.
 *
 * This macro defines a fixture test case that will be placed in BSS memory.
 * Requires CONFIG_ZTEST_BMEM to be enabled.
 *
 * @param suite The name of the test suite.
 * @param name The name of the test case.
 */
#define ZTEST_FCASE_BMEM(suite, name) \
	ZTEST_FCASE_DEFINE(suite, name, ZTEST_BMEM_SECTION)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ZTEST_TEST_H_ */
